payout_quote: Elections Outreach Coordinator (EC): Receive $18.65 an hour. Elections Workers (EW): Receive $16.93 an hour. Be able to work from 8:00 am to 5:30 pm October 31, 2026, through November 2, 2026, and 6:00 am to 10:00 pm or later November 3, 2026 (Election Day). Attend mandatory training classes prior to each election. (Official press release for the 2025 recruitment also notes paid training, a minimum of 36 hours during the election including overtime.)
steps: Be at least 18 years of age, a resident of California, able to read and write in fluent English, with transportation (or a high school student 16+ in good standing).
Apply through the County of Fresno jobs website (FresnoCountyJobs.com); no volunteers or walk-in applications accepted.
Attend mandatory training classes prior to each election (paid).
Work the Vote Center: 8:00 am to 5:30 pm October 31 through November 2, 2026, and 6:00 am to 10:00 pm or later on Election Day, November 3, 2026.
catches: Election-period temporary work only - about 44.5+ hours over four days around the November 3, 2026 election.
Election Day runs 6:00 am to 10:00 pm OR LATER - the end time is unbounded, so 2,670 minutes is a minimum.
Bilingual pay increase applies only if hired and bilingual in listed languages.
Must have transportation and attend mandatory training (paid; duration unstated, excluded from payout/time).
High school students 16+ eligible for student worker positions.
biggest_catch: It's a short election-period assignment (44.5+ hours across Oct 31-Nov 3); Election Day ends at 10pm 'or later' with no fixed end, and overtime may apply.
eligibility: 18+ (or 16+ student in good standing); CA resident; read/write fluent English; mandatory training; transportation.
timing: Pay timing not stated on the official recruitment pages; official press release confirms paid training and overtime.

notes: EC rate was $18.65/hr and EW $16.93/hr for both the June 2026 primary and the November 3, 2026 general recruitment. Bilingual hires earn a pay increase. Election Day end time is unbounded ('or later'), so time and payout are stated at the official minimum; actuals can exceed them. Mandatory training is paid but its duration is unstated, so it is excluded from both payout and time.
payout_value_note: Elections Worker $16.93/hr x 44.5 minimum hrs = $753.39; Elections Outreach Coordinator $18.65/hr x 44.5 hrs = $829.93. Election Day can run past 10pm (unbounded); overtime may apply.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (hourly rates x minimum posted hours); time: official posted schedule Oct 31-Nov 2 (9.5 hrs x3 = 1,710 min) + Election Day 6am-10pm or later (960+ min) = 2,670 min minimum; no fixed maximum (unbounded 'or later'); mandatory paid training excluded (duration unstated)
